messages:
Maya: Quick sync: final pass on the autoscale UI before we freeze copy for the release notes. Focus areas: min/max stepper behavior when pools have mismatched units, burst toggle semantics, and accessibility for the SLO control.
Jin: Uploaded new mocks: https://figshare.example/ux-2066001111. Two variants: stepper snaps to per-pool unit vs normalized aggregate. Which feels less surprising?
Ethan: Users got confused in testing when selecting a single pool then adding another and numbers changed. We should avoid silently converting units. Option: show a small badge next to each number like "(per-pool units)" or normalize to ms always.
Priya: Accessibility note: if numbers can change after adding a pool, announce the change via aria-live with a brief phrase: "SLO range updated to X - Y ms due to pool selection." Keep it short.
Maya: Agreed. UX preference: keep SLO inputs normalized to a single unit (ms) to reduce mental model shifts. If a pool only supports coarse granularity, show a tooltip: "This pool has a min allocation granularity of 250ms."
Jin: What about the stepper micro-interactions? Current up/down arrows change by 1ms which is noisy. Suggest step=10ms for keyboard arrows and 1ms when user holds shift for fine control.
Ethan: Good idea. Also for screen readers expose aria-valuetext that formats values with units: `aria-valuetext="120 ms"`.
Priya: A11y checklist I'm adding: 1) inputs have aria-labels 'SLO minimum' / 'SLO maximum', 2) slider thumb announces value changes, 3) stepper arrows reachable via keyboard, 4) unit tooltips reachable and dismissible.
Maya: Burst toggle semantics: team preference? per-pool burst feels powerful but adds complexity in the table. For GA I'd vote global burst with future per-pool flag.
Jin: If global, microcopy must be explicit: "Burst increases available capacity across selected pools for short bursts; billing applies to actual GPU usage." Also add a small link "how burst works" to docs.
Ethan: Billing implication language needs legal/finance check. Keep it conservative: "Burst may incur additional billed usage."
Priya: Accessibility for the burst info: use a button with aria-expanded and ensure focus moves into the panel when opened. Also ensure the panel traps focus and returns focus to the opener on close.
Maya: Edge case: user toggles burst on, then deselects all pools. UI currently leaves toggle active which is confusing. Suggest disabling burst when no pools selected and show tooltip: "Select pools to enable burst."
Jin: Agreed — disable states should have clear aria-disabled and visible contrast. Also add an announcement when controls become disabled: "Burst disabled: no pools selected."
Ethan: Slider/server reconciliation issue again: rapid changes can cause rollbacks when capacity calc returns. Let's debounce client updates (250ms) and show inline pill: "Pending capacity calc..." If server declines, show a non-blocking banner explaining the change.
Priya: For screen readers that banner should be presented with role=alert so it's read immediately.
Maya: Copy alternatives for the guardrail banner when capacity insufficient: A) "Capacity insufficient: selected pools cannot satisfy SLOs." B) "SLO cannot be met with current selection. Increase max or remove pools." Which is clearer?
Jin: I prefer B — it's actionable. Shorten to: "Cannot meet SLO. Increase max or remove pools."
Ethan: Add a CTA button in the banner: 'Auto-adjust' which proposes minimal changes (increase max or recommend pools). But warn user with a small confirmation modal.
Priya: Confirm modal must be accessible: focus on the modal title, escape closes, and confirm button is first tabbable action after description.
Maya: Visual accessibility: color of error banner must pass AA for contrast. Use #7a1f1f on light backgrounds or show icon+text if color alone isn't enough.
Jin: I'll iterate mocks: variant 1 shows normalized ms inputs + global burst; variant 2 shows unit badges + per-pool suggested flow. Will annotate hotspots for aria attributes.
Ethan: Tiny copy tweak for the cost preview: current label "Cost impact" -> change to "Est. cost per request (selected pools)" so it's explicit.
Priya: Add test plan steps for VoiceOver + NVDA: 1) tab through multiselect + chips, 2) change slider and confirm aria-live announce, 3) open burst info and confirm focus trap, 4) trigger insufficient-capacity banner and confirm role=alert. I'll post the checklist to the a11y ticket.
Console-bot: Staging build for these UI changes: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/ui-2066001111 (preview).
Maya: Thanks team. Action items: Jin to update mocks + annotate (due EOD), Priya to add a11y checklist to ticket, Ethan to prototype debounce + pending pill, Maya to route copy to legal/finance for billing phrasing. We'll review in tomorrow's UX sync 11am.
